formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (x1 : ℕ) (x2 : (Fin x1 → Bool) → Bool) (x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (x4 : Fin x1),   PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x3 →     PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun x1 x3 = x2 →       (∀ (x7 : ℕ), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasCircuitSize x1 x2 x7 → x3.size ≤ x7) →         (∃ (x8 : Fin x1 → Bool) (x9 : Fin x1 → Bool), x2 (Function.update x8 x4 Bool.false) ≠ x2 (Function.update x9 x4 Bool.false)) →           (have x9 : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate := List.filter (fun (x9 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) => (List.take (bif x9.op.eval [Bool.false] then (1 : ℕ) else (2 : ℕ)) x9.inputs).contains ↑x4) x3.gates;             (4 : ℕ) ≤ x9.length ∨ x9.length = (3 : ℕ) ∧ ∃ x10 ∈ x9, x10.op ≠ PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) →             ∃ (x10 : ℕ), x10 + (4 : ℕ) ≤ x3.size ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasCircuitSize x1 (fun (x11 : Fin x1 → Bool) => x2 (Function.update x11 x4 Bool.false)) x10)
plain_statement: It is false that: One of 2 statements that together prove: Let G be a graph with at least one edge, every cycle of length at least 7, A a set of vertices met by no edge, and every vertex outside A with exactly 3 neighbours. Write F(H) for the function true when a variable of A is true or both ends of an edge of H are true. Then some vertex v outside A has: whenever an AND, OR, NOT circuit of fan-in at most two (every gate counted) with s gates computes F(G), some such circuit with at most s - 4 gates computes F(G - v), where G - v is G with the edges at v deleted. Conjecture.
title: It is false that: Part 1 of 2 of a proof of: Cubic piece, cycles at least 7, edge function plus OR-variables: a vertex whose deletion lowers fan-in-two AND/OR/N
